gloss: nationally popular; beloved by the whole nation

definitions.gloss: nationally popular; beloved by the whole nation
definitions.explanation: Describes something that enjoys overwhelming popularity or recognition across the entire country, transcending age, region, and social class.

examples.japanese: {国民的|こくみんてき}⟦アニメ→アニメ：01527_anime⟧だ。
⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{歌手|かしゅ}→歌手：00197_kashu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{国民的|こくみんてき}⟦スター→スター：00393_sutaa⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{呼|よ}ばれている→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧。
examples.english: That singer is called a national star.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦ドラマ→ドラマ：03867_dorama⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{国民的|こくみんてき}な⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{得|え}て→得る：02014_eru⟧、⟦{視聴率|しちょうりつ}→視聴率：08381_shichouritsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{四十|よんじゅう}→四十：01009_yonjuu⟧⟦パーセント→パーセント：01537_paasento⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{超|こ}えた→超える：01942_koeru⟧。
examples.english: This drama gained nationwide popularity, with ratings exceeding forty percent.

notes:
USAGE:
{国民的|こくみんてき} is a media and conversational term used to highlight that something has transcended niche appeal and become part of the shared national culture. It is frequently used with entertainment and sports figures.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {国民的|こくみんてき}⟦アニメ→アニメ：01527_anime⟧ (nationally beloved anime)
- {国民的|こくみんてき}⟦スター→スター：00393_sutaa⟧ (national star)
- {国民的|こくみんてき}⟦{行事|ぎょうじ}→行事：00078_gyouji⟧ (national event)
- {国民的|こくみんてき}な⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧ (nationwide popularity)
- {国民的|こくみんてき}⟦{英雄|えいゆう}→英雄：14117_eiyuu⟧ (national hero)
